# flaggr_service (Resource)

Manages a Flaggr service within a project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "flaggr_service" "api" {
  project_id  = flaggr_project.platform.id
  name        = "API Gateway"
  description = "Primary API gateway service"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Service name.
- `project_id` (String) ID of the project this service belongs to.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Service description.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Service ID.
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly identifier.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = flaggr_service.api
  id = "your-service-id"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Services are imported by service ID.
terraform import flaggr_service.api "your-service-id"
```
